summary: Independent review found no blocking or important issues. Two-row ms-proteomics SDRF maps the partial PRIDE deposit of recombinant human osteopontin digested with thermolysin versus trypsin; file names, original ThL raw/search paths, peptide cleavage, and methods all support keeping thermolysin rather than recoding it as trypsin.

reviewer_context.context: fresh hook agent without producer transcript

spec_compliance.evidence: Active template independently derived as ms-proteomics v1.1.0 (usable_alone; declared NT=ms-proteomics;VV=v1.1.0). Required ms-proteomics/base/sample-metadata columns present; factor last; no empty cells; unique source+assay; human/cell-lines templates correctly unused for purified recombinant protein. parse_sdrf -t ms-proteomics online: Everything seems to be fine. python3 -m tools structure: Structure OK.

ontology_integrity.evidence: python3 -m tools check: 11/11 terms verified, 0 hallucinated/mismatched/UNIMOD swaps. OLS4 resolved NT/AC pairs to current labels: PRIDE:0000627 Data-dependent acquisition; MS:1001911 Q Exactive; MS:1003979 Thermolysin (not obsolete); MS:1001251 Trypsin; MS:1000422 beam-type collision-induced dissociation; UNIMOD:21/35/7 Phospho/Oxidation/Deamidated; NCBITaxon:9606 Homo sapiens. Cache-only parse_sdrf missed MS:1003979; online parse_sdrf accepted it.

source_evidence.evidence: Identity-checked PRIDE accession PXD038135 title matching PMC9779928 / PMID 36569898 / DOI 10.3389/fimmu.2022.1079775. Methods and PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: recombinant human OPN digested with trypsin or thermolysine; QExactive DDA; PEAKS 8.5; 15 ppm / 0.05 Da; phospho STY, ox M, deamidated NQ. mzML MS:1001911 Q Exactive (not PRIDE's Q Exactive HF). Search mods omit carbamidomethyl despite PX MOD:00397.

file_mapping.evidence: PRIDE files list projectAccessions PXD038135 only. Two RAW files LT_OPN_Thermolysine.raw and LT_OPN_Trypsin.raw match comment[data file] exactly; no extra/missing raw rows. PEAKS Source File names 180924_OPN_Egesten_ThL.raw and 180903_OPN_Egesten_1800.raw are pre-deposit originals of those two runs.

design_consistency.evidence: n=2 assays, 2 sources, 1 technical replicate, fraction 1, label-free, factor=cleavage agent details with two levels matching the two deposited files. Biological replicate=1 each; no hidden fractions or labels. Partial PRIDE deposit (submissionType PARTIAL) of OPN characterization, not the murine infection study.

omission_safety.evidence: Did not copy PRIDE sampleAttributes CF/COPD onto recombinant OPN. Did not recode thermolysin as trypsin. Did not add carbamidomethyl or Q Exactive HF against file-level counterevidence. Expression host HEK293 vs E. coli is not in deposited filenames; phospho-positive P10451-only PEAKS tables match pOPN characterization at file granularity without inventing a host factor.
